title: Resume MCP access and enter verification codes directly
items: Existing MCP clients can continue after locking and unlocking Harbor and choosing Resume MCP access, without restarting the client app.
MFA, password and SSH key selection prompts focus their first field so you can type, paste or select a key immediately.

title: Update Harbor from Settings
items: Download updates directly in Settings on Windows and Linux, with progress, cancellation and retry.
Install and restart when you are ready. Harbor asks before disconnecting active sessions and preserves your saved vault and local settings.
View releases & downloads remains available for manual updates. Current macOS builds continue to use this option.
See offline release highlights in What’s new, with optional announcements after updates.

title: Desktop runtime update
items: Updated Harbor’s bundled desktop runtime. No separate runtime installation is needed.
Existing vaults, settings and SSH workflows stay the same.

title: Persistent sessions and quick navigation
items: Keep remote commands running after disconnecting with optional tmux sessions. Enable this per host; tmux must already be installed on the server.
Persistent tabs return after locking and unlocking Harbor. Choose Reconnect to resume your session.
Find hosts, terminals and workspaces with Ctrl+K, or Cmd+K on macOS.
Clearer broadcast controls and more reliable backup identification and background mode.
